open_points.subject: public_op:deliverer_router.create_app
open_points.text: The redirect is decided by the path alone, whatever the method and before any check of the route, the token and the body among them; the redirected request is then judged at the route's path, where a method the route does not have answers 405.
open_points.question: Does a trailing-slash request for a protected operation receive an unauthenticated 307 before A5 rule 1, or must a missing or invalid Authorization field produce the UNAUTHORIZED refusal before any redirect?
options: Return 307 before authentication and treat the redirect as outside the operation governed by A5 rule 1.
Apply A5 rule 1 to the trailing-slash request and return the UNAUTHORIZED refusal instead of redirecting.
Authenticate first, then return 307 only when the token is valid.
open_points.default_guess: Return 307 before authentication, treating the explicit redirect rule as a routing step outside the protected operation.

witness.initial: The service is listening and a confirmed project has the protected scan route at /v1/projects/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/photos.
events: The caller sends GET /v1/projects/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/photos/ without an Authorization field.
outcomes: The changed State 5 passage answers 307 before checking the token.
A5 rule 1 refuses the request with the UNAUTHORIZED member of RefusalCode because it has no Authorization field.
witness.observer: The HTTP caller sees either a 307 redirect or the M08 unauthorized response.
